_notes.purpose: One row per SATPIN week that has a CVC sentence AND filed art (see docs/curriculum/montree-phonics/CVC_SENTENCE_LINE.md for the canonical sentence table). Weeks with a sentence but no art yet (l/w20, j/w21, x/w24) are simply absent from this list -- build_cvc.py only ever builds what is here, it never fabricates a row.
_notes.slug: Matches the per-letter slug used everywhere else in the pipeline (app/montree/library/satpin/page.tsx WEEKS[]) so the sheet can drop into the existing public/satpin-materials/<slug>/ folder alongside that letter's paperwork-pack.pdf / tracing-workbook.pdf / etc.
_notes.art: Filename only, resolved under phonics-images/satpin-v2/cvc/w<NN>/ (zero-padded week number).
_notes.keyword: The scene's own decodable word, read straight off its art filename (w04-tap.png -> 'tap') -- used as the caption under its picture box and, for other weeks, as a distractor caption. Never invented.
